Junction City, KS 66441
Hours: Monday through Friday
Effective June 1, 2026:
County Offices are open 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m. Monday - Thursday; and 8:00 a.m. - 12:30 p.m. on Fridays
Some offices are available by appointment before and/or after hours - see individual department pages for operating hours and contact information.
On Fridays , the Treasurer’s Office is open by appointment only, no walk-ins.
